source_instruction: i need some high fructose citrus tonic water.
query: Dude, you will not believe the squirrel that just darted across the grocery store parking lot five minutes ago—he was hauling an entire half-eaten glazed donut clamped tight in his tiny jaws, hopped right up the trunk of the big oak by the cart return like he didn’t have a care in the world, and even paused on a low branch to stare me down like he was daring me to try and take his snack. I stood there for a full minute just cackling because he had little smears of powdered sugar dusted all over his fuzzy little cheeks, and a lady loading reusable bags into her minivan next to me started laughing too when I pointed him out. It was such a silly, random little moment that it totally made my otherwise boring errand run feel way brighter, I swear I’m still grinning thinking about how proud he looked of his stolen pastry prize. Hey, I’m grabbing some drinks from the alcoholic beverage section right now—can you help me pick something out? I need a bottle that has high maltose listed as an ingredient, max budget is $120, and also make sure it’s that one flavor I always grab, y’know the usual? Oh, and it absolutely has to come with a free branded metal bottle opener attached to the neck, that’s non-negotiable for me right now. Wait, did I mention I’m heading to a casual backyard cookout later? No, never mind that, just stick to what I said about the drink specs.
